name: verzel-leiloes-ricardo
description: Casa de leilões fictícia para o teste técnico Elite Dev da Verzel

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
